newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Main European airlines' traffic up 13pct yr-yr Nov.
newsitem.headline: Main European airlines' traffic up 13pct yr-yr Nov.

text.p: Passenger traffic carried by major European airlines last November rose 13 percent year-on-year, a "remarkable" five-percentage-point increase, the Association of European Airlines said on Thursday.

"Intra-European traffic grew by 8.4 percent, well above the expected year-end figure of six percent. All other regions experienced double-digit increases -- plus 14.1 percent in the case of the north Atlantic and 13.6 percent for the Far East," the AEA said in a news statement.

Capacity offered by the 26 member airlines of the AEA, which include the region's major flag carriers, increased 10 percent on the previous year. Combined with passenger growth, this boosted aircraft load factors 1.8 percentage points to a new November record of 66.9 percent.
Meanwhile, total freight carriage on AEA airlines in November rose 3.1 percent year-on-year.

The headline figure included increases of 6.7 percent for freight carried within geographical Europe, 19.7 percent for the combined area of Europe, North Africa and the Middle East and 3.3 percent on the largest market -- to and from the Far East and Australasia.
